events.source_title: HKMA, Regulatory regime for stablecoin issuers

events.title: Anchorage issues USDtb in partnership with Ethena Labs
events.detail: Anchorage says it has issued USDtb in partnership with Ethena Labs and will be its sole issuer from here on. The page does not name the earlier issuer.

events.title: J.P. Morgan launches the JPMD deposit token
events.detail: Offered by Kinexys to institutional clients; B2C2, Coinbase and Mastercard completed test transactions. No balance is published.
events.source_title: J.P. Morgan newsroom, JPM Coin USD deposit token, 12 Nov 2025

events.title: Kraken agrees to buy Backed
events.detail: Kraken has agreed to acquire Backed Finance AG, the company driving the issuance of xStocks. No price, terms or closing date were given.
events.source_title: Payward press release, Kraken to acquire Backed, 2 Dec 2025

events.title: State Street and Galaxy announce SWEEP
events.detail: A tokenized private liquidity fund for qualified purchasers that takes subscriptions and redemptions in PYUSD. Ondo was expected to seed it with about $200 million.
events.source_title: State Street Investment Management and Galaxy press release, 10 Dec 2025

events.title: SEC staff give DTC no-action relief for a tokenization pilot
events.detail: DTC may launch a pilot version of its DTCC Tokenization Services, in which participants elect to hold security entitlements as tokens in registered wallets on approved blockchains. The relief ends three years after the pilot launches.
events.source_title: SEC Division of Trading and Markets, no-action letter to DTC, 11 Dec 2025

events.title: OCC conditionally approves Paxos's conversion to a national trust bank
events.detail: One of five conditional approvals announced on 12 Dec 2025. The September 2026 KPMG report names the issuer as Paxos Trust Company, National Association.
events.source_title: OCC News Release 2025-125, 12 Dec 2025

events.title: OCC conditionally approves Ripple National Trust Bank
events.detail: A de novo national trust bank charter, conditionally approved on 12 Dec 2025.
events.source_title: OCC News Release 2025-125, 12 Dec 2025

events.title: OCC conditionally approves five national trust bank charters
events.detail: New charters for First National Digital Currency Bank and Ripple National Trust Bank; conversions for BitGo Bank & Trust, Fidelity Digital Assets and Paxos Trust Company. Circle's 10-Q identifies First National Digital Currency Bank as Circle National Trust. Fidelity is not yet on this ledger.
events.source_title: OCC News Release 2025-125, 12 Dec 2025

events.title: J.P. Morgan Asset Management launches MONY on Ethereum
events.detail: A 506(c) private placement fund that invests only in US Treasury securities and repurchase agreements backed by them. Investors subscribe and redeem through Morgan Money using cash or stablecoins.
events.source_title: J.P. Morgan Asset Management press release, 15 Dec 2025

events.title: DTCC and Digital Asset plan to mint DTC-custodied Treasuries on Canton
events.detail: A subset of US Treasury securities custodied at DTC to be minted on the Canton Network, with an MVP targeted in the first half of 2026. DTCC will join the Canton Foundation as co-chair alongside Euroclear.
events.source_title: DTCC press release, DTCC and Digital Asset partner, 17 Dec 2025

events.title: NYSE announces a platform for tokenized securities
events.detail: A platform for trading and on-chain settlement of tokenized securities, with 24/7 operations, instant settlement, orders sized in dollars and stablecoin-based funding. NYSE will seek regulatory approvals; no launch date is given.
events.source_title: ICE press release, The New York Stock Exchange Develops Tokenized Securities Platform, 19 Jan 2026

events.title: SEC staff set out how securities law applies to tokenized securities
events.detail: Staff of three divisions sort tokenized securities into those tokenized by or for the issuer and those tokenized by third parties, either custodial or synthetic. A staff view; the Commission neither approved nor disapproved it.
events.source_title: SEC Divisions of Corporation Finance, Investment Management and Trading and Markets, Statement on Tokenized Securities, 28 Jan 2026

events.title: ICE invests in OKX
events.detail: ICE announced a strategic relationship and investment that values OKX at $25 billion, with a seat on OKX's board. Terms were not disclosed.
events.source_title: ICE press release, ICE Makes Investment in OKX, 5 Mar 2026

events.title: SEC approves Nasdaq trading in tokenized form
events.detail: Release 34-105047. Nasdaq must alert members at least 30 calendar days before tokenized trading begins.
events.source_title: SEC order approving SR-NASDAQ-2025-072, Release 34-105047, 18 Mar 2026 (Federal Register, 23 Mar 2026)

events.title: FDIC proposes its GENIUS Act rule

events.source_title: FDIC proposed rule, Federal Register, 10 Apr 2026

events.title: HKMA grants stablecoin issuer licences

events.title: Binance launches bStocks under ADGM-approved prospectuses

events.source_title: Binance release, Binance Exchange Launches bStocks Tokenized Securities, 12 Jun 2026

events.title: FCA publishes final rules for the UK crypto regime, including stablecoin issuance
events.detail: Policy statements PS26/9 to PS26/13, including PS26/10 on stablecoin issuance. UK-issued qualifying stablecoins must be fully backed and redeemable at par. Applications open 30 Sep 2026 to 28 Feb 2027; the regime's full scope applies from 25 Oct 2027.
events.source_title: FCA, Overview of our cryptoassets regime policy statements, 30 Jun 2026

events.title: Robinhood Chain mainnet goes live with Stock Tokens

events.title: MiCA's transitional period ends

verification.method: Each of the 30 cited sources was fetched with WebFetch on 14 Nov 2026 (long filings and Federal Register documents in several offset windows) and every number, date, name and definition sentence in the 104 rows was compared with what the source prints; the five explorer supplies and the two Ondo pages were compared with the live values, which matched the rows to the unit. Where a row states a fact that is not in its own cited source it is a finding even if another source on this ledger supports it, unless the row itself names that other source and I verified it there. Not checked: the full text of the Federal Reserve and FDIC proposals beyond their headers, the on-chain data behind any attestation, and the Business Wire release date, which appears only in the URL id (20260805) and not in the fetched text. Second pass, 14 Nov 2026 (60 new rows: reserve components, legal wrappers and five new players): Each of the 15 cited sources was fetched with WebFetch and every figure, name, date and held-at statement in the 60 rows was compared with the text as printed; PDF tables were re-added to their printed totals, and reports were fetched a second time to search for named custodians, banks and fund managers. Live sources matched the rows exactly on the day (Blockscout total_supply 533063044200 at 4 decimals = 53,306,304.42 MONY; Ondo OUSG as of 13 Nov 2026 and USDY as of 11 Nov 2026). Limits: PDFs were read as extracted text through a summarising fetcher, not as page images; the Business Wire copy of the ICE/OKX release carries its date only in the URL (20260305), which ICE's own copy on ir.theice.com confirms as 'Mar 05, 2026'; the BDO report covers one pooled reserve for all fiat-denominated Tether tokens with no per-token split, so the USDT rows are that pool; and status labels inside claims could be checked only against what the release says. Third pass, 14 Nov 2026 (14 rows from two SEC Form N-MFP3 filings): Fetched both cited N-MFP3 XML documents from sec.gov with WebFetch (the Franklin document in two parts, characters 0-100000 and 100000-167751, through its closing tag; the WisdomTree document whole) and compared every number, date and name in each row with the printed element values, then re-summed the four components of each fund. Filing dates and the presence of later N-MFP3 filings were checked against the two data.sec.gov submissions indexes. Values were read out by the fetch tool's extraction model over two differently worded passes per document, not from a raw byte copy. Fourth pass, 14 Nov 2026 (52 rows: RLUSD, USDe, USDS, PAXG, XAUT, USYC, JLTXX, USTB, SWEEP, DTCC, Mastercard and the FCA): Each of the 19 cited sources was fetched with WebFetch (plus the J.P. Morgan AM CUSIP snapshot cited inside h-usdgo-jltxx and the EDGAR filing index), and every figure, date, name and definition sentence in the 52 rows was compared with the text as printed; the 1,068,017-character N-CSRS was read in eleven 100,000-character windows plus targeted passes on the OnChain fund's statements and notes. Gold values (ounces x US$4,157.41) and the USTB value (on-chain shares x $676,987,663 / 60,015,423.56 = $11.2802280) were recomputed and match to the dollar, and live sources read on 14 Nov 2026 matched exactly (Blockscout XAUT 827,417.63, RLUSD 2,019,899,967.19, USDe 4,909,359,615.97, USDS 5,318,034,118.92, USTB 39,660,945.507784; XRPScan RLUSD 762,824,103.291486; Ripple $2,689.9M and $2,826.5M as of 11/12/2026; Circle $312,976,695.16; Superstate $676,987,663). Limits: text was read through a summarising fetcher, not page images; the Business Wire page prints no date (URL 20251210, matched by a MarketScreener/S&P Capital IQ copy dated 12/10/2025); Circle lists 'BNB', read as BNB Smart Chain; o-ustb-ethereum matches only with the unrounded NAV (at exactly $11.2802 it would be $447,383,398); two 'missing' findings name rows that do not exist and are not counted in rows_with_findings. Passes 5 to 9 (14 Nov 2026) checked batch three, tokenized equities, plus four rows left unchecked after pass 4: 33 rows, then the 14 rows changed after pass 5, the 4 changed after pass 6 and the Nasdaq order row after passes 7 and 8, each by a fresh agent that had not seen the work, against the cited page or its mirror of the company's own release. Two pass-5 findings (Ondo and bStocks amounts shown as None) came from the check file leaving out amounts; the pages state the counted figures. Passes 10 and 11 rechecked the Ondo Stocks and bStocks readings with their amounts included; one clause in the Ondo note that rested on another page was moved to a gap note.

Supported: this is a Federal Register document (Vol. 91, No. 55, March 23, 2026), so 'filed' holds. It is Release No. 34-105047, dated March 18, 2026. It approves SR-NASDAQ-2025-072 'as modified by Amendment No. 2'. Eligible securities are limited to 'securities in the Russell 1000 Index at the time the service launches', plus 'any additions to the index thereafter'. First, the order says the rule 'would become effective once the requisite infrastructure and post-trade settlement services have been established by DTC'. Nasdaq must also give members 30 days' notice. Second, same-book trading applies only if the tokenized share 'must be fungible with, share the same CUSIP number and trading symbol with' its traditional counterpart, and gives the same rights. Smaller point: the order says only 'the service' and never names it, so 'DTC's service' is an inference from the DTC Pilot context.
